newsitem.title: UK: Pharmacia & Upjohn sees Q3 shr near $0.44.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn sees Q3 shr near $0.44.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said on Friday it expected its earnings per share before non-recurring charges for the third quarter to be close to the $0.44 reported for the same period in 1995 on a pro-forma basis.
The company also said fourth-quarter and full-year earnings were expected to be more than those for the same periods last year.
Pharmacia & Upjohn said it planned to release its results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30 on October 31.
Pharmacia & Upjohn, which provides health care and related products, said sales for the quarter were up two percent from the period the previous year.
